steps.text: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
A few things
Including blaming the controller?
That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
Very glamorous evening planned
You look comfortable
I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
I saved that photo you took last night
So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
It really was. I'd missed that
Next time I'll find something better to watch
I don't mind the film that much
You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
Apparently that's my role now
You're very good at it 😌
A little later, her manager sends a message...
Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
A few people from work are having dinner
Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
Yeah, a few of us
All right, just let me know when you're back
I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
I won't forget to text you
Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
